critical.issue: Returns 500 (TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict') when the query pulls in older activity_logs rows that stored user_id as a dict. The set comprehension at edit_log.py line 44 `{r.get('user_id') for r in rows ...}` crashes. Only surfaces at higher limits on the master workspace because its legacy rows are further back. UI default limit=60 works, but any client whose history contains an older dict-shaped user_id will crash the panel.

integration_issues.issue: After selecting 'Newest review quote' the input didn't appear disabled and the 'Now showing: ...' hint (marquee-bottom_text-live) wasn't visible within 700ms of the change; likely a stale-state race between the save + refetch and the select's onChange re-render. The figure branch worked fine in the same run, and offer/review resolve correctly on the public site, so this is a UI-timing issue rather than a data bug. Worth verifying the editor waits on the refetch before recomputing `src`.

action_items: Fix backend/edit_log.py line 44: guard against non-string user_id values, e.g. `ids = list({r['user_id'] for r in rows if isinstance(r.get('user_id'), str)})`. Also consider `role_by_id.get(uid)` requiring uid to be a string. This unblocks any client whose activity history contains a legacy dict-shaped user_id.

MarqueeEditor.tsx: after `save({ [sk]: e.target.value })` on the source dropdown, ensure the disabled state + 'Now showing' hint update once the GET refetch completes (they do eventually, but the input momentarily looks editable). Consider optimistic setLocal(sk, e.target.value) before the round-trip so `src` flips immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/edit_log.py: `{r.get('user_id') for r in rows if r.get('user_id')}` assumes user_id is always hashable. Real data on app_testlab has some rows with dict user_id -> 500. Filter or coerce.

backend/marquee.py apply_live(): correctly formats figure text uppercase and falls back to `top_live='static'` when the source can't produce a line — verified live. Small nit: `_offer_live` compares ISO strings with `>` / `<` which works only because ISO dates are lexicographically ordered; fine as-is but a comment would help future maintainers.
MarqueeEditor.tsx line 133: input `value={val(k) || ''}` — when source is review/offer/figure the underlying static text is intentionally kept in state (so the user can toggle back). Good.
PortalPreview.tsx: uses a `key={src}` on the iframe so the refresh button (bump increment) properly forces a full reload. Good pattern; confirmed visually and via src-attr diff.
edit_log.py: `role_by_id.get(uid) or 'client'` — a user with an unknown membership record silently becomes 'client'. Acceptable default but consider distinguishing 'unknown'.

rca of the issue: GET /api/apps/{app_id}/edit-log crashes with `TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'` at edit_log.py:44 `list({r.get('user_id') for r in rows if r.get('user_id')})`. Some legacy documents in db.activity_logs have user_id stored as a dict (probably from an earlier logging call that passed the full user object instead of user_id). Set comprehensions cannot contain unhashable elements. Repro: `GET /api/apps/app_testlab/edit-log?limit=200` -> 500. Fix: coerce to string, e.g. `ids = list({r['user_id'] for r in rows if isinstance(r.get('user_id'), str) and r['user_id']})`. Also worth cleaning the legacy rows: `db.activity_logs.updateMany({user_id: {$type: 'object'}}, {$set: {user_id: ''}})` or similar.
